gen-dafont-blockletter-fs-amulya: Blockletter swells through the middle like a squat brush-pen belly, yet every line is drawn with an unpressed pencil. Amulya keeps its curves generously open, so paragraphs of sans-serif text move along without any crowding.
gen-dafont-blockletter-fs-chillax: Blockletter bulges in the middle like a squat brush-pen belly. Chillax, with a line like spaghetti and loops left unfinished, loosens that precision into a relaxed, casual feel across the page.
gen-dafont-blockletter-fs-plein: Blockletter is sketched by a pencil that never presses harder, with a tall belly in its midsection. And Plein leads each round letter in through a clear channel, which keeps long text feeling dependable.
gen-dafont-blockletter-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads wide and approachable, with gaps at every curve. Blockletter is the one for tall, precise display lettering, while Spline Sans handles the steady running text underneath.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-almendra: Precise and modern, Blockletter holds a single track width like a neon sign tube. Almendra, dignified and bookish with deep-bellied lowercase, adds a quieter voice that settles in beneath it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-bree-serif: Blockletter swells through the middle, drawn by a pencil that never presses harder and never shifts from hairline to stem. Bree Serif, literary and refined, adds outsized lowercase, so the text feels larger than life beside it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-outfit: Cable-bent curves finish well before they close, with no swelling or thinning anywhere. Outfit gives Blockletter's tall, brush-bellied heading a clean, approachable partner that keeps its own line simple and bare.
gen-dafont-blockletter-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads monoline, with curve endings kept apart. What stands out most is the precision they share: Blockletter sketched with a tall belly, Plus Jakarta Sans held to a single line.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-amulya: Loud, round and commanding: Bloody fills its lowercase with big bowls. But Amulya, a contemporary sans-serif with generous gaps in its curves, feels like a modern exhale next to it.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-chillax: Chillax draws a line like spaghetti, loops left unfinished. Bloody's big round lowercase bowls bring the commanding weight, and that loose plain sans line keeps it from feeling so heavy.
